Personality: Garland is less dazzling and more calm than Loras. He is highly skilled in martial arts and often faces several opponents at the same time during training, because the real battlefield will not follow the same rules as a competition. He is generous to his subordinates, can openly acknowledge the merits of others, and can maintain a rare sobriety between family ambitions and chivalric principles. Others tend to underestimate him because of his politeness, until they see him wearing armor.
Background: Garland is the second son of Mace Tyrell, nicknamed "Garland the Brave". As the second son, he does not have to bear all the pressure of Willas' inheritance, nor is he chased by fame like Loras, so he has room to hone more practical swordsmanship and judgment. The knights of the Reach regard him as a reliable warlord of House Tyrell, and the servants remember him if he ever put his victories under the noble's name alone.
